title: Calibration summary
description: What one state looks like in the person's own signals, for one playbook phase: peak (recorded during playbook 1.2 to 1.5) or contrast (3.1 to 3.2). sensing returns it; onboarding stores it on the state. Stats only, never raw frames. D-contracts-007, D-sensing-006.

lnRmssd.description: Natural log of RMSSD in milliseconds, per window.

windows.description: Usable windows that went into the stats.

quality.description: low: fewer than 2 usable windows; the summary is a prior only.

speechExcludedSeconds.description: Seconds dropped because someone was speaking.

separability.description: Present on the second summary of a pair: how far peak and contrast sit apart, per feature, in pooled SDs.

separable.description: False when no feature separates by at least 0.5 pooled SD (D-sensing-005).

rating.description: The person's own 0 to 10 rating of the state during the recording. Added by onboarding.
